news.h: Vikings left at QB crossroads after Carson Wentz's poor MNF showing vs. Bills
news.d: After a historically poor performance by Carson Wentz on Monday night, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell was asked if there was a chance the team would trade for a QB ahead of Tuesday's deadline. He deferred the question to GM Nolan Teasley.

news.d: Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz will start Monday night's game against the Buffalo Bills with Kyler Murray ruled out with a hamstring injury.
